in_marathi.name: Manitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'manas' meaning mind or intellect. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, representing wisdom and knowledge.
